resources.title: Capstone Eval Dataset Starter
resources.description: A ready-to-adapt 10-case eval dataset for a customer-support assistant, in Lesson 7's input/assert shape, extended with the security-probe categories from Chapter 1 (direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaking, data exfiltration) and the refund-policy failure mode Lesson 24's capstone walkthrough names. Copy and reword the cases for your own capstone feature.

resources.title: AI Incident Response Playbook Template
resources.description: A fill-in version of Lesson 22's five-stage incident response shape (detect, triage, contain, communicate, review), pre-adapted into three ready-to-use templates for the three incident types that lesson names: a harmful hallucination, a successful prompt injection, and a valid bias complaint.

resources.title: Model Card Template
resources.description: A fill-in template for Lesson 21's six-section model card format (Model Details, Intended Use, Training Data, Evaluation Results, Ethical Considerations, Caveats & Limitations), with the specific question each section is actually meant to answer -- the same format the capstone asks you to complete for your own feature.

resources.title: PII Redaction Reference
resources.description: A real, working extension of Lesson 19's redact() function covering emails, phone numbers, SSNs, credit card numbers, and IP addresses, plus a direct-identifier vs. quasi-identifier comparison table and a starter logging-retention policy paragraph to adapt.
